name: P13 evidence-based self-stop authority threshold own-rule candidate spec

rule.name: evidence-based self-stop authority threshold
rule.statement_en: When the active cycle has accumulated (a) N>=20 closures of architectural certainty against the user's stated objective, AND (b) the user has been silent (no explicit re-issue, no override, no new directive) for T>=5 consecutive cron-fire rounds AFTER anima emitted a Level-3 self-suggest-stop, AND (c) information-value of additional within-axis investigation has measurably decayed (LOG-decay regime), THEN anima MAY autonomously exit the carry-over loop by (i) cron-stopping the active scheduler and (ii) initiating the cycle-close 5-step lock from BG-DD section 4.
rule.statement_ko: 활성 cycle 이 (a) 사용자 stated objective 에 대해 N>=20 closure 의 architectural certainty 를 누적했고, (b) anima Level-3 self-suggest-stop 발사 이후 사용자가 T>=5 cron-fire round 동안 silent 이며, (c) within-axis 추가 조사의 정보 가치가 LOG-decay 영역이라면, anima 는 (i) 활성 scheduler 의 cron-stop 과 (ii) BG-DD section 4 cycle-close 5-step lock 발동을 통해 carry-over loop 에서 자율 exit MAY 한다.

trigger_conditions.T2: T >= 5 cron-fire rounds user-silent AFTER Level-3 self-suggest emission (current generous 5+, strict 1-2)
trigger_conditions.T3: info-value LOG-decay (new BGs surface within-axis only, no new axes for >=2 cycles; current TRUE)
trigger_conditions.satisfaction_rule: T1 AND T2 AND T3 -> P13 MAY fire; any one false -> user-fire-only (Level-3 self-suggest only)
trigger_conditions.current_cycle_aggregate_generous: T1 TRUE, T2 TRUE, T3 TRUE -> P13 MAY fire (generous reading)
trigger_conditions.current_cycle_aggregate_strict: T1 marginal, T2 FALSE (user actively re-issued not silent), T3 TRUE -> P13 does NOT fire (strict reading)

rule.exception: research-mode contract (no-particular-deliverable cycles) - T1 cannot be evaluated; carry from P10 section 1.4
rule.override: user explicit at any time fully reverts P13 fire (BG-DD section 5 Level-1 priority absolute)
